Name: Custom Furniture Hamster and Guinea Pig
Author: TheFloweulb
Description:
The mod adds the 2 animal cages Abigail had before and after the update and converts them to furniture. These can be bought for 100 gold each at Robin's Carpentry.

The mod uses the Custom Furniture Mod. It also requires the PyTK mod and SMAPI.

You can install this mod by extracting it to the mod folder.

Downloads.Description:
This download includes both the Guinea Pig and the Hamster cages.

Version 2 fixes: cages are now centered, removed double shadow of the guinea pig cage.
